# The Brigade Foundation

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-30 · status **partial** · Budget spent (8 searches, several document page-reads across 2 PDFs). Statutory CSR annexure figures obtained only for FY2024-25; FY2023-24 and FY2022-23 board's-report CSR annexures were not reachable.

Brigade Foundation is a not-for-profit trust that is the CSR arm of Brigade Enterprises Limited (parent, CIN L85110KA1995PLC019126, a listed Bengaluru real estate company). It operates primarily in Bengaluru/Karnataka across health, education/skilling, music/culture and environment. Found FY2024-25 statutory CSR figures for the parent (prescribed CSR Rs.739.87 lakh, spent Rs.740 lakh, impact assessment done) plus a broader 'whole group including BEL' CSR figure of Rs.10.72 crore for FY25, a flagship project (St. John's Medical College Hospital at Brigade Meadows, ~Rs.1 crore/year, 2267 beneficiaries), and several named programs (Brigade Schools, Interactive Music Museum, Venkatappa Art Gallery restoration with Government of Karnataka, Community Development). FY2023-24 and FY2022-23 statutory CSR annexures could not be reached (Scribd copy blocked; NSE PDF timed out repeatedly), so csr_year/csr_spend/footprint/partner rows for those two years are not_found. IMPORTANT: research_goals()/funder_dossier() for 'Brigade Foundation' returned an unrelated funder's data ([funder:9] SBI Foundation) due to an apparent fuzzy-name mismatch; that data was NOT used and Brigade Foundation's true held baseline appears to be empty.

Website: https://brigadefoundation.org

## What it set out to find

- identity and relationship to parent Brigade Enterprises Limited, without merging the two entities
- identifiers (PAN/CIN/CSR1/darpan) for Brigade Foundation
- funder_csr_years for FY2024-25, FY2023-24, FY2022-23
- funder_csr_spend (project/aggregate: sector, state, district, implementing agency, amount) for FY2024-25, FY2023-24, FY2022-23
- footprints and stated geography, kept separate
- named partner NGOs/implementing agencies by year
- programs run by Brigade Foundation
- metrics/outcomes
- published CSR contact mailbox
- documents (annual report, CSR annexure, sustainability report)
- open RFPs / partner-with-us calls
